structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions

text.section: The Virginia Center on Aging (the Center) shall be located at the University and shall be an interdisciplinary study, research, information, and resource facility for the Commonwealth. The Center shall utilize the full capability of the faculty, staff, libraries, laboratories, and clinics of the University for the benefit of older Virginians and the expansion of knowledge relating to the aged and the aging process.
The Center is subject to the supervision and control of the board.
The board shall appoint an advisory committee for the Center.

The board shall appoint an executive director for the Center who shall:
Exercise all powers and perform all duties imposed upon him by law;
Perform all duties imposed upon him by the board; and
Employ such personnel and contract for such services as may be required to carry out the purposes of this section.
